Run order: `00_survey_data.Rmd` (samples and site registry) ->
`python/environmental_timeseries_pull/update_env_cache.py` (pulls climate data for any
registry cell-dates not yet cached) -> this script (climate and KG joins, model data).

## Setup

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| output: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show setup code"

# setup
librarian::shelf(tidyverse, here, janitor, terra, arrow)

bd_model_clean = readRDS(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "bd_survey_clean.rds"))

```

## Environmental data
To support comparing Bd prevalence and loads between sites and species across a range of environmental conditions, I incorporated local (~5 km) daily maximum temperature (CHIRTS) and daily precipitation (CHIRPS) time series. Following Sonn et al. 2019 [sonn2019effects], I created 10-day and 30-day means (for tempurature) and sums (for precipitation). Preliminary model fitting showed stronger relationships between Bd prevalence and 10-day lag products, while Bd load showed stronger relationships with 30-day lag products, similar to Sonn et al. 2019.

### Daily climate by grid cell
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show environmental data loading code"

# CHIRPS and CHIRTS share a 0.05 deg grid; sites are mapped to cells by update_env_cache.py
site_cells = read_csv(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "site_registry_cells.csv"),
                      col_types = cols(site = "c", cell_id = "c"))

missing_cells = setdiff(unique(bd_model_clean$site), site_cells$site)
if (length(missing_cells) > 0) {
  stop("sites without a grid cell (rerun update_env_cache.py): ", paste(missing_cells, collapse = ", "))
}

cache_dir = here("python", "environmental_timeseries_pull", "env_cache")
read_env = function(product) {
  read_parquet(file.path(cache_dir, paste0(product, ".parquet"))) %>%
    filter(cell_id %in% site_cells$cell_id) %>%
    transmute(cell_id, date = as.Date(date), value)
}

# CHIRTS tmax from GEE through 2016, from CHIRTS-ERA5 from 2017
env_daily = full_join(
  read_env("chirps") %>% dplyr::rename(precipitation_mm = value),
  bind_rows(read_env("chirts_tmax"), read_env("chirts_era5_tmax")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(temperature_max_c = value),
  by = c("cell_id", "date")) %>%
  # one row per calendar day, so the rolling windows below span calendar days
  group_by(cell_id) %>%
  complete(date = seq(min(date), max(date), by = "day")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(cell_id, date)

```

### Rolling windows
```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show rolling window code"

env_agg = env_daily %>%
  group_by(cell_id) %>%
  mutate(precip_mm_10_day_sum = zoo::rollapply(precipitation_mm, 10, sum, fill = NA, align = "right"),
         precip_mm_30_day_sum = zoo::rollapply(precipitation_mm, 30, sum, fill = NA, align = "right"),
         temp_c_10_day_mean = zoo::rollapply(temperature_max_c, 10, mean, fill = NA, align = "right"),
         temp_c_30_day_mean = zoo::rollapply(temperature_max_c, 30, mean, fill = NA, align = "right")
         ) %>%
  ungroup()

# continuous 7-day blocks (52 * year + week(date) merged Dec 31 into the next year's week 1)
env_var_index = env_daily %>%
  mutate(week_number = as.integer(date) %/% 7)

env_var_week = env_var_index %>%
  group_by(cell_id, week_number) %>%
  # na.rm: a block can straddle the edge of a site's date window (days outside it are not pulled)
  summarize(weekly_precipitation_mm = if (all(is.na(precipitation_mm))) NA_real_ else mean(precipitation_mm, na.rm = TRUE) * 7,
            weekly_temperature_max_c = if (all(is.na(temperature_max_c))) NA_real_ else max(temperature_max_c, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(cell_id) %>%
  mutate(past_year_weekly_precipitation_mm_sd = zoo::rollapply(weekly_precipitation_mm, 52, sd, fill = NA, align = "right"),
         past_year_weekly_tempurature_max_c_sd = zoo::rollapply(weekly_temperature_max_c, 52, sd, fill = NA, align = "right")) %>%
  ungroup()

env_agg_all = env_agg %>%
  left_join(env_var_index %>%
              select(cell_id, date, week_number), by = c("cell_id", "date")) %>%
  left_join(env_var_week %>%
              select(cell_id,
                     week_number,
                     past_year_weekly_precipitation_mm_sd,
                     past_year_weekly_tempurature_max_c_sd), by = c("cell_id", "week_number")) %>%
  select(-week_number)

```

### Join with env. data
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show environmental data merging code"

bd_model_env = bd_model_clean %>%
  left_join(site_cells %>%
              select(site, cell_id), by = "site") %>%
  left_join(env_agg_all, by = c("cell_id", "date"))

# every sample needs climate values: missing ones mean the cache lacks those cell-dates
env_missing = bd_model_env %>%
  filter(is.na(precip_mm_10_day_sum) | is.na(temp_c_30_day_mean)) %>%
  count(taxon_capture, site, cell_id, name = "n_samples")

if (nrow(env_missing) > 0) {
  print(env_missing, n = 50)
  stop(sum(env_missing$n_samples), " samples without climate values (rerun update_env_cache.py)")
}

bd_env = bd_model_env %>%
  mutate(
    precip_mm_10_z = as.numeric(scale(precip_mm_10_day_sum, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    precip_mm_30_z = as.numeric(scale(precip_mm_30_day_sum, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    temp_c_10_z = as.numeric(scale(temp_c_10_day_mean, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    temp_c_30_z = as.numeric(scale(temp_c_30_day_mean, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))) %>%
  select(taxon_capture,
         everything())

```

## KG zones
```{r}

kg_key = read_csv(here("data", "koppen_geiger_tif", "legend.csv")) %>%
  select(-rgb) %>%
  rename_with(function(x) { paste0("kg_", x) })

all_sites = bd_env %>%
  group_by(site, population, country) %>%
  summarize(site_latitude = mean(site_latitude),
            site_longitude = mean(site_longitude),
            taxa = paste0(sort(unique(taxon_capture)), collapse = ", "),
            taxa_n = n_distinct(taxon_capture),
            adult_n = sum(life_stage_simple == "adult"),
            subadult_n = sum(life_stage_simple == "subadult"),
            .groups = "drop")

site_coords = cbind(lon = all_sites$site_longitude,
                    lat = all_sites$site_latitude)

kg_rast = rast(here("data", "koppen_geiger_tif", "1991_2020", "koppen_geiger_0p00833333.tif"))

kg_extract = extract(kg_rast, site_coords) %>%
  dplyr::rename(kg_id = koppen_geiger_0p00833333) %>%
  mutate(kg_id = if_else(kg_id == 29, 19, kg_id))

all_sites_kg = bind_cols(all_sites,
                          kg_extract) %>%
  left_join(kg_key, by = "kg_id")

peace = get_dupes(all_sites_kg, site)

bd_env_kg = bd_env %>%
  dplyr::select(-site_latitude,
                -site_longitude) %>%
  left_join(all_sites_kg %>%
  dplyr::select(site,
                site_latitude,
                site_longitude,
                kg_code_1,
                kg_code_2,
                kg_code_3), by = "site")

ggplot(all_sites_kg, aes(x = kg_code_2, fill = kg_code_3)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_y_log10()

```
# checks
```{r}

count_na = function(df, cols) {
  df |>
    summarise(across(all_of(cols), ~sum(is.na(.)))) |>
    pivot_longer(everything(),
                 names_to  = "column",
                 values_to = "n_na")
}

check_na_cols = c("bd_load_co0_density",
                  "bd_load_co30_density",
                  "bd_load_co100_density",
                  "bd_load_co300_density",
                  "bd_load_co1000_density",
                  "life_stage_simple",
                  "taxon_capture",
                  "precip_mm_10_z",
                  "temp_c_30_z",
                  "kg_code_3",
                  "population",
                  "date",
                  "year")

na_col_check = count_na(bd_env_kg, check_na_cols)

if (sum(na_col_check$n_na) > 0) {
  print(filter(na_col_check, n_na > 0))
  stop("NAs found in model variable columns. Please review.")
}

```

```{r}
brms_data = bd_env_kg

save(brms_data, file = here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", paste0("bd_model_env_unified_", today(), ".RData")))
write_csv(all_sites_kg, here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "size_bd_modeling_sites.csv"))

```

# population species and year distributions
```{r}
pop_spp = brms_data %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  summarize(n_taxa = n_distinct(taxon_capture),
            .groups = "drop")

pop_year_spp = brms_data %>%
  group_by(population, year) %>%
  summarize(n_taxa = n_distinct(taxon_capture),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(pop_spp, aes(x = n_taxa)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15) +
  scale_y_log10()

ggplot(pop_year_spp, aes(x = n_taxa)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15) +
  scale_y_log10()

```

# plot annual variability
```{r}
plot_data = brms_data %>%
  distinct(country,
           region,
           site,
           date,
           precip_mm_10_day_sum,
           temp_c_30_day_mean,
           past_year_weekly_precipitation_mm_sd,
           past_year_weekly_tempurature_max_c_sd)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = past_year_weekly_tempurature_max_c_sd, y = past_year_weekly_precipitation_mm_sd, color = region)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = past_year_weekly_tempurature_max_c_sd, y = temp_c_30_day_mean, color = region)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = precip_mm_10_day_sum, y = past_year_weekly_precipitation_mm_sd, color = region)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = precip_mm_10_day_sum, y = temp_c_30_day_mean, color = region)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2)

ggplot(brms_data, aes(x = past_year_weekly_tempurature_max_c_sd, y = past_year_weekly_precipitation_mm_sd, color = log(bd_load_co100_density))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2)

ggplot(brms_data, aes(x = past_year_weekly_tempurature_max_c_sd, y = log(bd_load_co100_density), color = taxon_capture)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05)

ggplot(brms_data, aes(x = past_year_weekly_precipitation_mm_sd, y = log(bd_load_co100_density), color = taxon_capture)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05)
```

# sampling coverage by species: projects, climate zones and environmental ranges
```{r}
# who is missing projects?
peace = brms_data %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, project) %>%
  count()

brms_data |>
  group_by(taxon_capture, kg_code_3) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  count(kg_code_3, taxon_capture) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = kg_code_3, y = n, fill = taxon_capture)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill")

# Precipitation
brms_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = taxon_capture, y = precip_mm_10_day_sum)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Precipitation distribution by taxon",
       x = NULL, y = "10-day precipitation (mm)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Temperature
brms_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = taxon_capture, y = temp_c_30_day_mean)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "tomato", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Temperature distribution by taxon",
       x = NULL, y = "30-day mean temperature (°C)") +
  theme_minimal()


```
